source_organization: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Tamil Nadu) — ₹1,000 a month for girls
description: For girl students who studied Class 6 to 12 in a Tamil Nadu government or government-aided school and are now in a regular higher-education course (degree, diploma, ITI, professional). No family-income limit. Distance and correspondence courses are not covered. Apply through your college. No fixed last date was confirmed — ask your college. The document list below may be shorter than the portal's.
benefits: ₹1,000 every month for the length of the course, paid to your bank account by DBT.
required_documents: School study certificates (Class 6 to 12, TN government / aided school)

source_organization: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
name: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme (Tamil Nadu) — ₹1,000 a month for boys
description: For boy students who studied Class 6 to 12 in a Tamil Nadu government or government-aided school and are now in a regular higher-education course. No family-income limit. Students from private schools are not eligible. Apply through your college. No fixed last date was confirmed — ask your college. The document list below may be shorter than the portal's.
benefits: ₹1,000 every month for the length of the course, paid to your bank account by DBT.
required_documents: School study certificates (Class 6 to 12, TN government / aided school)

name: Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Scholarship — SC / ST (Adi Dravidar & Tribal Welfare)
source_organization: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
description: For SC, ST, SCC and SCA students who are Tamil Nadu residents, from Class 11 up to PhD in a recognised Tamil Nadu institution. Family income up to ₹2.5 lakh (income certificate from the Tahsildar). Sources disagree on the last date (31 Oct vs 30 Nov 2026) and on whether you apply on the state portal or NSP — confirm both with your college. The document list below may be shorter than the portal's.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement plus maintenance allowance; hostel allowance for hostellers.
